title: AI Voice Parent Call
scenario: A caller sounds like your parent and says to send a code from their phone immediately.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: AI Voice Parent Call: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Hang up and call your parent’s saved number yourself.
